system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the lexicographically-least circular substring algorithm. It extends the main algorithm specification and provides finite instantiations of the constants needed for exhaustive model checking, including a finite character set and a bounded override for the natural numbers to make the state space finite.
actors_and_components: Same as the main algorithm specification. This module adds constants for the character set size and maximum string length, and defines finite overrides for the character set and the natural numbers.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the main algorithm specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the main algorithm specification, but with the corpus (set of all valid input strings) restricted to strings whose characters come from a finite set of size equal to the configured character set size, and whose lengths range from 0 to the configured maximum string length.
actions: Inherits all actions from the main algorithm specification without modification.
safety_properties: Inherits from the main specification: the type invariant and the correctness property (upon termination, the computed offset identifies the lexicographically-minimal rotation).
liveness_properties: Inherits from the main specification: termination.
model_bounds: The character set size is configured as a constant (e.g., 2 or 3 characters). The maximum string length is configured as a constant (e.g., 6 or 8). The infinite set of natural numbers is overridden with a finite range from 0 to the maximum string length, ensuring all sequence-related computations terminate. The character set is overridden with the integers from 0 to one less than the character set size.
additional_assumptions: This module exists solely for model checking. Two configuration variants are provided: a small configuration (character set size 2, max length 6) and a medium configuration (character set size 3, max length 8). The natural number override is scoped to the zero-indexed sequences utility module to ensure all length computations use the bounded set.
